name: months_at_current_saving
description: Checks that with 400 a month the upfront cost (4,430) is worked out by a module and then used by the months module, with the savings of 1,000 as given.
lines: If I can only put aside 400 a month, how long until I can pay for the move? The deposit is 1,200 and the van hire is 380. I will pay three months of overlapping rent at 950 a month, and I have no other costs. I have saved 1,000 so far, not counting my emergency fund, and the move is in 7 months. Please go ahead with those figures.
